candidates.author: G. K. Chesterton
candidates.sourceEdition: The Man Who Was Thursday: A Nightmare, J. W. Arrowsmith, Bristol, with London distribution by Simpkin, Marshall, Hamilton, Kent & Co., 1908
candidates.notes: Project Gutenberg eBook #1695 is the complete-text candidate and is listed public domain in the USA. The 1908 original scan is identified by Wikisource with 340 pages; all pages of the work proper are marked validated and fully transcluded there, but that Wikisource transcription is CC BY-SA and must not be copied into CICAN without meeting its attribution/share-alike terms. The original scan must be independently collated against the Project Gutenberg text, including front matter, chapter structure, and ending. Irish term calculation: author died 1936; Ireland's life+70 rule indicates expiry at the end of 2006 (public domain from 1 Jan 2007), subject to edition-specific rights review. US publication date is 1908; Gutenberg identifies its edition as public domain in the USA. Territorial legal sign-off and named human transcription review remain outstanding. Do not publish until all gates pass.
